items.text: Martin McLaughlin is a small business owner and pension manager who has represented the 52nd District since 2021. He was elected Village President of Barrington Hills in 2013; his campaign says he reduced the property tax levy by over 24%.

sentences.text: Martin McLaughlin is a small business owner and pension manager who has represented the 52nd District since 2021.
He was elected Village President of Barrington Hills in 2013; his campaign says he reduced the property tax levy by over 24%.

items.text: He has proposed bills regarding the general homestead exemption amount and a senior property tax freeze. He supports increasing municipalities' share of state income taxes from 5% to 10% to provide alternative revenue. He has called for repealing the SAFE-T Act and says he will vote against tax increases. He introduced a bill to allow the recall of school board members. He says he proposed a state budget with over $5 billion in savings.
